_doc: art_spice: Spice: random gate lengths, ratchets and silences over the pattern; non-destructive: it always starts from the pattern before spice, amount 0 gives it back, and the same amount gives the same changes (until art_dice or art_mutate rolls new ones).
_amount: How much spice (0..1): more amount keeps the changes of less and adds more.
_amount_per_level: With the knob: each level of a longer turn adds this much amount.
_gate: share: how many notes (at full amount) get a new gate length; short / long: the weights of one step versus a tail (up to max_tail_steps, never past the next note).
_ratchet: share: how many notes (at full amount) get ratchets; max: the most hits (2..max).
_silence: How many notes (at full amount) fall silent.
_keep_first_note: Never spice the first note of the pattern.
_seed: null: a new spice pattern per track when it starts; a number: repeatable.
